title: Generator Fibonacci
description:
Implement an infinite `fibonacci` generator that yields Fibonacci numbers starting from 0.

**Example:**
```js
const gen = fibonacci();
gen.next().value; // 0
gen.next().value; // 1
gen.next().value; // 1
gen.next().value; // 2
gen.next().value; // 3
```
ai_context: Common mistake: starting with [1, 1] instead of [0, 1], which skips 0. Also using a temporary variable for swapping instead of destructuring assignment, which can introduce bugs.
